title: Error Analysis of a Fully-Discrete Implicit $θ$-Scheme with WG-FEM for Parabolic Singularly Perturbed Boundary Turning Point Problems
summary: In this article, we introduce a weak Galerkin finite element method (WG-FEM) for a class of parabolic singularly perturbed boundary turning point problems (SPBTPPs). The proposed numerical scheme employs an implicit $θ$-scheme for temporal discretization over a uniform mesh and applies WG-FEM spatial discretization on a layer-adapted Shishkin mesh. Rigorous stability estimates are established for both the semi-discrete and fully-discrete formulations.
